decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Any replacement brickwork, pointing, and the new casement window, shall be in accordance with Technical Notes 1 and 3 of the Bedford Park Society's Guidance for Residents and Archiitects.

Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the works are commenced, a scheme showing details of the new opening between the existing building and the new conservatory shall be submitted to the local planning authority. The new opening shall be expressed as an arch (segmented) and visible from both sides (in and out). The works shall be completed in accordance with these approved details.
Condition : 5 - All new flashings shall be in lead.
description: Erection of single storey rear/side conservatory and replacement of side window to dining room with encasement window to dwellinghouse
